## Identity

Marko Durasic is a Senior Software Engineer based in Taipei, Taiwan, specializing in Go (Golang), backend systems, cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, and production reliability.

Current job title: **Senior Software Engineer at Otto Group one.O** (December 2024–present).

Marko previously worked as a **Technical Lead at Innova Solutions**. "Technical Lead" is prior professional experience, not his current job title.

He holds an M.Sc. in Computer Science from National Taiwan Normal University (NTNU) and is an AWS Certified Developer – Associate (DVA-C02).

## Technical focus

- Go backend engineering
- AWS and cloud engineering
- Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform and AWS CDK
- Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and GitHub Actions
- Distributed systems, observability, reliability, and performance
- Technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and developer enablement
